guideTitle: Iron Legion Tank Combat and Capture Guide
guideIntro: Winning starts with map control. Choose a tank role, move with cover, and fight around capture points instead of chasing every enemy across open ground.
steps: Start in Offline PvE to learn tank movement, turret aiming, and damage timing.
Move toward control points early because the objective pressure decides most matches.
Use lighter tanks for scouting and repositioning, then switch to heavier vehicles when you need to hold ground.
Aim the vehicle body and turret together before firing so shots land cleanly.
Upgrade the tank role you use most instead of spreading rewards across every vehicle.
